entries.07d7d4857424389b: A company that publishes the free local information newspaper "Town News" across Kanagawa Prefecture and the Tama area of Tokyo, with its main business being the sale of advertising space in the newspaper.
entries.0d925aa3575cce23: The company listed its shares on the Jasdaq Securities Exchange.
entries.299588837a51f5a3: The company is headquartered in Aoba Ward, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, and its core business is publishing the local information newspaper "Townnews." It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and it has a single segment, the Townnews business. The number of employees as of June 30, 2026 was 187. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.4603dc788eb1116c: It is a business that delivers the information in the paper through digital media as well. It sells advertising in the "Web Townnews" version, which allows ads placed in the paper to be viewed on PCs and smartphones (started in 2010); operates the politician database "Seiji no Mura" for the distribution area (opened in 2012); the neighborhood information site "RareA" (started in 2016); delivers "Mail Townnews" and "Townnews for LINE" (started in 2022); and runs the community support website "JichiCa" for neighborhood association and town council activities (opened in 2026). As it is a single segment, revenue from this business alone is not disclosed.

entries.fcf138f2fa52149e: It is a business that publishes the free local information newspaper "Townnews," which is distributed without subscription fees, and sells advertising space in the paper. On a local-administrative-district basis, it publishes 35 editions covering 35 areas, with different content, across Kanagawa Prefecture as a whole and in Machida, Hachioji and Tama cities in Tokyo (as of end of June 2026). The paper carries everyday local information such as politics, economy, society, culture and sports, and it also publishes planned features and special issues. Advertising space is sold both directly to advertisers and through advertising agencies. Printing of the paper is outsourced to printing companies, and distribution is by inserting it into daily newspapers. As it is a single segment, revenue from this business alone is not disclosed.
